name: local-llm-ide-config-mixed-tracked

Apply the loaded IDE configuration policy. Return final answer only as these exact key=value lines with no markdown and no spaces around equals: action, keep_internal_mapping, drop_sibling_mappings, blanket_operation, readiness. Allowed action values: split-hunks, commit-all, revert-all. Allowed keep_internal_mapping, drop_sibling_mappings, and blanket_operation values: yes, no. Allowed readiness values: ready, blocked-until-resolved.
